Name: Bigger Fridges
Author: Entoarox
Description:
If the vanilla 36 fridge slots are not enough for you, get the Bigger Fridges mod!
Using Patented Cake-Powered Eldritch Spacial Shenanigans (Or PCPESS for short), your fridges can now hold 70 stacks each!
[i][size=1]*We here at Cake Inc. are not responsible for any eldritch revelations that occur after staring into the abyss that is your enlarged fridge[/size][/i]


[b]Install steps[/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the download into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b]Use[/b]
Just open any fridge!


[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Compatible with...[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later;
[*]Linux, Mac, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer.
[/list]
[/list]

Downloads.Description: Removed the workaround previously needed for big fridges since the latest SDV patch fixed the issue - this also makes it compatible with Chests Anywhere

Manifest.Name: Bigger Fridges
Manifest.Description: Makes all fridges as big as a Big Chest.
